text:
Jordan (AcmeFS): hey team -- our rerank calls started failing after the deploy yesterday. getting 404 / model not found for model_id 'rerank-x-small-v1'. unsure if we hit a deprecation or a routing bug. cc @Emma - example curl + response below

Emma - Support: sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact request body + headers (tenant id + model id) and the full error blob? also did you use a model alias or a concrete model id?

Jordan (AcmeFS): here's the request we use from our backend (node):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...\" \
  -H \"X-Tenant-ID: acme-fs\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model_id":"rerank-x-small-v1","queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["a","b","c"]]}'
```

and the response body we see: 

```json
{"error":{"code":"MODEL_DEPRECATED","message":"model id \"rerank-x-small-v1\" not found or deprecated","details":null}}
```

Rae (Infra): thanks @Jordan. quick checks: the model id `rerank-x-small-v1` was retired in last night's model roster update and replaced by `rerank-x-small-v2`. Normally we keep alias-mapping so tenant aliases continue to work for 7 days. are you calling a tenant-scoped alias or the concrete id?

Jordan (AcmeFS): we're sending the concrete id from our service config (we pinned to the old id months ago). we didn't use an alias intentionally.

Sasha (Eng): likely scenario: the concrete id was removed from the model registry and the routing layer now rejects requests for it (404/DEPRECATED). If you used an alias you would've been auto-routed to v2. Because you pinned the concrete id, you see this error.

Emma - Support: okay — two paths: 1) quick workaround: switch to the new id `rerank-x-small-v2` (recommended) OR 2) we can temporarily remap the retired id back to the v2 artifact for your tenant only while you roll. Which do you prefer?

Jordan (AcmeFS): we need to test compat; can you do the temporary remap for acme-fs while we run an integration test? that buys us a day to validate.

Rae (Infra): I can do a tenant-scoped alias remap. doing it now.

DeployBot: model-roster-update triggered by deploy: model `rerank-x-small-v1` -> retired (2025-11-04T03:12:09Z).

Rae (Infra): remap applied: `acme-fs` tenant now routes requests for `rerank-x-small-v1` -> `rerank-x-small-v2` (tenant-scoped). TTL: 24h. Please validate and let us know.

Jordan (AcmeFS): confirmed initial rerank call succeeds after remap. thanks!

Emma - Support: great — followup items: 
- Sasha: can you add a postmortem note about pinning concrete model ids and recommend alias usage in the SDK docs?
- Product: consider an automated tenant-notify when a pinned id is scheduled for retirement (we had release notes but the tenant pinned a concrete id).

Sasha (Eng): yup will add a short doc entry and a snippet showing `model_alias` header usage and the safer pattern: `model_alias: rerank-x-small` (aliases decouple retirements).

Jordan (AcmeFS): one more thing: is there any billing/latency impact we should expect from the remap?

Rae (Infra): no billing change — requests still billed the same. latency is unchanged (same serving variant). the only risk is if you relied on an internal behavior change between v1 and v2; we'll leave the remap short-lived so you can test and then move to v2.

Emma - Support: I'll keep this thread open until you confirm complete migration. tagging the account team to follow up. :thumbsup:

Jordan (AcmeFS): thanks all, switching to the new id in CI now, will post results shortly.
